name: halcyon
description: Halcyon — AI-native email, calendar and contacts suite (web + Windows desktop)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm start -w desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w desktop
scripts.dist:win-arm64: npm run build && npm run dist:win-arm64 -w desktop
